question: The DE analysis cannot start from the raw paired-end FASTQ files because this sandbox has no RNA-seq quantification tool available (no STAR, HISAT2, Salmon, kallisto, Rsubread, or featureCounts in the package census) and no genome/transcriptome sequence FASTA in the reference store to build an index from (only a GRCh38 GTF annotation, chrom.sizes, and ClinVar VCF are present — no .fa/.fna). Quantification (alignment + gene-level counting, or pseudoalignment to transcripts) is a required upstream step with its own consequential choices (aligner/mapper, reference build, decoys, annotation) that this plan cannot skip or approximate. Please provide one of: (1) a gene-level count matrix or Salmon/kallisto transcript-level quantification files for the 6 liver samples (3 treated vs 3 control), already produced from these FASTQs, or (2) provision a quantification tool (e.g., Salmon, STAR, or Rsubread) plus a matching genome/transcriptome FASTA in the reference store so quantification can be run before differential expression.
